extract.note: left out: the copyright page and the front note on the file set, eBible.org's own texts, for which eBible.org states no license (the rights statement is quoted in the license text)

licenses.text:
Londona Biblio, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/epo/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/epo/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in Esperanto (1910)
> Public Domain
> Language: Esperanto
> 2020-02-13

What was found:
Text: "La Sankta Biblio" (the London Bible), 1926, British and Foreign Bible Society and National Bible Society of Scotland; Old Testament by L. L. Zamenhof (died 1917), revised by a named British committee.

Why it stays out: missing fact: the death years of the named members of the 1919-1926 Bible Translation Committee that revised the 1926 London Bible (C. G. Wilkinson, H. O. Allbrook, M. J. Elliott, C. Gaydou, T. S. Lindsay, J. E. McFadyen, A. Poynder, E. J. Price, W. Bailey, J. M. Warden, William Harvey); Rust (died 1927), Beveridge (died 1943), Page (died 1940) and Wackrill (died 1924) are found.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=epo), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/epo/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bible_translations_into_Esperanto; https://eo.wikipedia.org/wiki/Londona_Biblio.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)
